title: Falsely banned.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

Your first punishment for disrespect today was completely valid: https://gyazo.com/c7b2d05e35abe16a04278bd57636c3e6. This type of behavior in chat is not tolerated, even if another player is breaking rules. In addition, staff members cannot punish players without seeing or having evidence of them breaking rules. If you claim that a player team spleefed you, the best thing to have done was to report them and watch to see if they do it again, or record them spleefing you. Seeing the team spleef in chat does not suffice for a punishment as it may have been a mistake, and staff members need to see that it was deliberate. As for your second punishment, it was also valid: https://gyazo.com/f03488671db98281ed4196bc88da385c. Your ban's length is barely two hours, your infractions were justified, and you've received similar punishments in the past. Therefore, your appeal has been denied.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
